title: continuity-report@1
description: Continuity report: the read-only JSON that `custody_cli audit` emits. It is a READING of a mission, not an authority record -- nothing writes it into a mission store, so it never reaches the chain, the receipts directory, or atomic_write_json's pre-write validation. This schema therefore describes what a consumer must be able to traverse, not that the findings are true. Validation authority: verify_mission_custody.py (stdlib); this schema is the contract for consumers that do not execute it.

continuity_breaks.description: Where an artifact changed between two receipted events without a receipted event of its own. Emitted by Mission.continuity_breaks().

expected_before_sha256.description: The prior receipt's after_sha256, which receipt@1 types as a plain string. Never null.

observed_before_sha256.description: The next receipt's before_sha256, which receipt@1 types as string-or-null; null is how a first write records that nothing was there.

orphaned_retired_receipts.description: Ids whose loss was acknowledged but whose receipt file is still present. Emitted by Mission.orphaned_retired_receipts(). These are OBJECTS, not strings.
